facts.fact: ANPTIC states it hosts the administration's business software, websites and collaborative platforms in public-administration data centres and runs a cloud IaaS portal with 492 virtual machines created for government structures (undated page, published date used).

ANPTIC lists under its own 'services and applications developed' the government systems Bondoo, Tawale, Toumnana (SIGED), SIGEPE, Helpdesk and e-conseil des ministres (undated page, published date used).
